# iShares holdings fixtures

Holdings files as iShares serves them, trimmed to a few lines each (the header block, a handful of
share lines, the cash and futures lines). Downloaded 2026-10-21 from the issuer's public pages;
the lines are kept verbatim.

| File | Source | Form | Holdings as of |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ewj_us.csv` | `https://www.ishares.com/us/products/239665/fund/latest-holdings.csv` (iShares MSCI Japan ETF) | the US site's: a fund header block, `Oct 20, 2026`, `Currency` (the fund's) and `Market Currency` (the line's) | 2026-10-20 |
| `iwda_uk.csv` | `https://www.ishares.com/uk/individual/en/products/251882/fund/latest-holdings.csv` (iShares Core MSCI World UCITS ETF) | the UK site's: one date line, `20/Oct/2026`, `Market Currency` only | 2026-10-20 |
